summary: Zero screens remain, but this is an RNG-only mismatch: the giant spider covers a pit and JS skips dig.c:bury_objs, leaving the dropped organic scroll unburied. C calls obj_resists twice and rnd(250) while burying it; JS then starts monster-turn RNG three calls too early. Port whole bury_objs and wire its active callers; this case covers only the spider-over-pit branch, while shop accounting and other callers still need coverage.

source.branch: A hero polymorphed into a web spinner uses #monster while standing on a PIT or SPIKED_PIT with a floor object at the same coordinates. dospinweb emits the web message, deletes the trap, buries objects at that square, redraws it, and spends a turn.
callers: polyself.c:dospinweb 1553-1560 calls bury_objs after deleting a PIT or SPIKED_PIT; js/polyself.js:2364-2370 currently records note_unported("dig.c bury_objs"). This case executes that branch.
do.c:boulder_hits_pool 90-98 calls bury_objs after a boulder fills liquid terrain; js/do.js:716-724 currently records the skipped call.
do.c:flooreffects 883-889 calls bury_objs when a boulder plugs a hole or trapdoor; js/do.js:883-889 currently records the skipped call.
hack.c:moverock_core 544-566 calls bury_objs when a pushed boulder plugs a hole or trapdoor; js/hack.js currently stops at its broader boulder-trap boundary before this source branch.
zap.c:bhitm 5277 calls bury_objs when a cold effect freezes liquid terrain; js/zap.js:5100-5104 currently records the skipped call.
dig.c:wiz_debug_cmd_bury calls bury_objs under #ifdef DEBUG; verify whether the recorder build includes this command before counting it as an active entry point.
dependencies: Reuse and source-check dig.c:bury_an_obj as implemented in js/bury.js; it returns the saved next floor-object pointer consumed by bury_objs while object extraction mutates the chain. This path invokes zap.c:obj_resists for the initial zero-chance protection check and, for organic objects, the rot check before rnd(250).

Port the whole dig.c:bury_objs behavior: costly/shop-keeper check, stolen_value return accumulation and no_charge mutation, per-square object iteration, del_engr_at, newsym, maybe_unhide_at, and the debt message. This case uses an ordinary non-shop square and does not establish the costly-shop branch.

The admitted case exercises only polyself.c:dospinweb. The boulder-pool, boulder-hole/trapdoor, and cold-freezing callers need independent runtime evidence for source-task closure. dig.c:bury_obj is inside #if 0 and is not an active caller.

evidence: The examined queue entry at challenges/evaluations/20261006225046-v24.json, evaluated at 84d84e111155ac834c43327b7c696055df294349, has 57 recorded steps, 57/57 matched screens and cursors, and 2719/2728 matched RNG calls. Its first mismatch is segment 0 step 53 on Enter: C rn2(100)=95 from zap.c:obj_resists; JS rn2(12)=11 from the next monster movement turn.

A targeted replay of only this case (`node scripts/scan-sessions.mjs --json --synthetic v24/v24-spider-web-over-pit`, bounded run-7d0PeL) reproduced the same step and source attribution at replay commit 3470fce7b2ee7ab949c421ea2abd70fac3854b4e: 57 screens, no screen/cursor divergence, C RNG length 2728 and JS RNG length 2725. The inspected dig.c, polyself.c, do.c, hack.c, zap.c and corresponding JS caller files are unchanged between that replay commit and examined commit 84d84e111155ac834c43327b7c696055df294349.

The session drops a scroll of gold detection before #monster. C polyself.c:dospinweb PIT branch 1553-1560 calls dig.c:bury_objs after the message and deltrap; dig.c:bury_objs 2050-2086 iterates the floor-object list and calls dig.c:bury_an_obj. For this organic paper scroll, bury_an_obj calls obj_resists(0,0), then obj_resists(5,95), then rnd(250) to start its organic timer. Those three C draws are absent because js/polyself.js:2369 skips the entire bury_objs call; subsequent monster-turn RNG is shifted, explaining the remaining positional mismatches. No screen, cursor, or input-stop defect was found.

The targeted scanner diagnostic is cached at .cache/synthetic-scans/v24/v24-spider-web-over-pit.json. That local artifact confirms dig.c:bury_objs is listed among the segment unported paths and that the game consumed the full recorded input.
